title: Wait a Minute, WHO ARE YOU?
blurb: Betrayed confusion, delivered at an intensity the situation never came close to deserving. The line comes from a 1989 instructional video about playing the kazoo, of all things, which the internet dug up and turned into one of its most enduring artefacts. It works for identity crises at every scale — an unrecognised number texting something familiar, a stranger in the group photograph nobody can place, a friend after a significant glow-up. Wait a minute. Nobody has improved on that delivery since, and nobody is going to.
origin: From the viral 'You on Kazoo' video: the kazoo kid's iconic line.
